title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode7 Intermediate Results

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Here are the current standings...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The red team is in the lead by a large margin with the green team trailing behind and the blue team in last.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! All according to plan!
The cheering competition will be ours as well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you know it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Second place...
If only I did a little better during the ball toss.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A little...?
Neither of us really did much of anything during that event.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! Last?!
I thought we were doing pretty well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we still have the cheering competition during the second half! We still have a chance, so we've gotta get ourselves ready for that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no! Rui, the blue team's in trouble!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it's rather unfortunate.
However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may make things just that much more interesting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You have that look on your face, Rui. I'm looking forward to what you have in store for us during the cheering competition.>

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
The final showdown.
Just like last time, we're going to win by putting on a performance that proves how far beneath me you are.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes, let us wish each other the best of luck...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this...?
Have you already accepted defeat?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
No...
Think of this as the calm before the storm.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Now... My fellow squad members and I just need to do our best during this performance. They were willing to bet on my passion, so I want to light a fire inside them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Captain...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hah. You talk big, but what's the point in putting on a performance that has no chance of winning?

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I'm not losing to that.
You'll soon realize that we've pulled out all the stops for our performance. Now, if you'll excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There he goes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He really likes to shout whatever's on his mind and leave right after, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But what you said just now almost brought a tear to my eye, Captain!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially when you said, “They were willing to bet on my passion...” That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I-It was?
I'm not sure what to say...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I threw down the gauntlet just now, so we're going to have to put on an incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this is the final Sports Festival for those two... I'm sure the captain of the red team's feeling just as passionate...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (On top of that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and the others aren't going to pull any punches. I'm sure they have something spectacular in store for us...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I guess I'll just sit back and watch their performance as a member of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
The cheering competition for the Kamiyama High School Sports Festival will now begin.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The theme for this year is the “Three Kingdoms”. Our first performance will be by our current leaders, the red team.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Alright, red team, take it away.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
Akito and his team are kicking off the cheering competition.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Speaking of which...
I've been wondering why he's been coming home all exhausted lately. This must've been why.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what their performance is like.
se_event_cheerteam_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I'm hearing drums...
And a three-three-seven clapping beat?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Interesting. They seem to be going with something fairly standard, but we'll see how this plays out...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the red teeeaaam!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Loud!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa's voice must be permeating the entire school... No, probably outside the campus too. He certainly knows how to set the mood.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Have you forgotten which team you're on?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A three-three-seven clapping beat that makes full use of Tsukasa's tremendous voice. It's not a bad idea, but this doesn't seem like anything all that special...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Akito?
With a huge flag too...
se_event_cheerteam_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go!
se_event_cheerteam_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He's so fast...!
So powerful too...!
se_event_cheerteam_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way he's waving the flag is also very beautiful. He's like a horse galloping across a battlefield.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I see. Shinonome must be the “Red Hare”.
The horse that could cover hundreds of miles in a single day...)
se_event_cheerteam_2022_004

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
The drums... They've stopped?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<They've stopped cheering too...
What's going on?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Why'd they all stop?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this the end of their performance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, wait...
I hear something...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(...!
Shinonome's singing while holding that red headband.)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wow! His voice is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: And really encouraging for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, he was reluctant at first, but he gladly accepted after I explained to him that we needed his help and that only he could fill this part for the red team's cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, he's certainly playing a vital role.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(His voice is being followed by another...
And another...)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, were they always on the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
That means the others are also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh wow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone on the red team's singing!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The seats for the blue and green teams are being surrounded by members of the red team! When did that happen?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This must be their way of showing that they're “invading” the blue and green “kingdoms”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to commend them for incorporating today's seating arrangement into their performance like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone's singing louder and louder!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Normally, being surrounded like they are would be very uncomfortable, but looking at how the red team's behaving...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <The louder they sing, the more they become a single unit.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Their red headbands seem to be representing small flames. They appear insignificant on their own, but combine to become a roaring blaze...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It isn't too terribly ostentatious, but it's easy to understand and serves to bring everybody on the red team together.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is awesome...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get why this event's so famous now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we aren't about to go quietly...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Everyone on the red cheer squad, thank you all very much. Next, we have the green team. Please start getting ready for your performance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Th-That was so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Especially all the singing!
It was hard not to feel overwhelmed when they all surrounded us like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Tsukasa's booming voice and singing were really amazing too. Inspiring and empowering at the same time, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shinonome also did a wonderful job. I couldn't believe how he ran around at the speed he did and managed to catch his breath before singing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a tough act to follow. The green team's gotta be feeling the pressure.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I agree. The red team's performance was no doubt incredible. It clearly accomplished its goal of “encouraging” the red team.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: However, with that in mind, I believe our performance is nothing to sneeze at, no...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone was even willing to practice the idea I decided to include at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I have a feeling that our performance is something truly special. Which just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Us giving it absolutely everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As it stands, the blue team is in last place... A part of me was worried that we'd be too demoralized to keep competing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that's also why our performance will mean just that much more to our fellow teammates.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's do one last check...
We need to make this moment count.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So let's give our performance the effort it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Squad Members
rows.Line: Yeah!
